title: Wakazi wa Bustani Mbili
intro: Katika nchi ambayo baraka zilitiririka kwa wingi, jamii moja iliwahi kufurahia wingi wa bustani mbili nzuri. Maisha yao yalikuwa ushuhuda wa neema ya Mungu, lakini hadithi yao ilibadilika shukrani ilipopungua, na kusababisha mabadiliko ambayo yangekuwa ishara ya kudumu kwa wote wanaotafakari.
clues: Tulikuwa watu waliobarikiwa na nchi ya raha na wingi.
Mola wetu alitupatia bustani mbili nzuri, zenye majani mengi na zenye matunda kila upande.
Tuliamriwa tushukuru, lakini tulichagua kutoshukuru na tukageuka.
Bwawa kubwa lilizuia maji yaliyoipa ardhi yetu uhai.
Tulipoendelea na makosa yetu, bwawa lilipasuka na maji ya mafuriko yakapita.
Bustani zetu ambazo hapo awali zilikuwa na mimea mingi zilibadilishwa na matunda machungu, mivinje, na miti michache ya mikuyu.

outcome.answer: Bustani zetu zilibadilishwa na matunda machungu na miti michache

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
